title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Canada-eligible remote roles plus hybrid roles in Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall and Montréal. Scores measure technical and domain fit; logistics and compensation are separate.
latest_update: Latest update: September 18, 2026 — full role-family and eligible-city rerun completed.

notes_sections.heading: Validation notes
items: H2 Analytics, both Newton roles, Caylent, Tailscale Infrastructure Engineer, and Movable Ink are already applied.
Caseware and StackAdapt are already rejected but remain visible so the search is complete.
CIRA is recorded as applied September 16. Its six-month Ottawa hybrid contract closely matches Marc's CI/CD standardization and enablement work; GitLab CI/CD depth is the main gap.
ClickHouse is confirmed expired, and Branch is no longer available on the employer site as of September 16. Both remain visible and labeled Expired.
Confirmed stale roles are excluded from the 25-current-posting count.
Could not validate: Desjardins, Programmer Analyst — DevOps and Platform Reliability. Built In's search result was current, but the direct posting returned an internal error, so it was not scored.
No eligible Cornwall-only posting survived validation. Montréal and Ottawa hybrid roles with unclear cadence remain flagged.
Banyan's description permits remote work in Canada while Built In labels the role Toronto in-office; confirm before applying.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 refresh delta
items: Elastic — Senior SRE, Observability & Analytics is the strongest new match: Canada remote, CAD $128,300–$203,000, with unusually direct alignment across Terraform, Python, Linux, ELK, ArgoCD, Ansible, on-call, RCA and mentoring.
Redwood Software — Senior SRE is a plausible stretch, but the role expects substantially deeper production AWS networking, EKS, Datadog and RDS/PostgreSQL operations.

Kindred, Ciklum, Webflow and SecurityScorecard were retained with low-to-moderate scores because their full descriptions expose hard gaps in deep AWS ownership or shipped AI/full-stack customer solutions.

Could not validate regional eligibility: GitLab Orbit and Very Good Security expose complete requirements, but their direct pages do not explicitly confirm that these specific openings accept a Canada-based worker.

Zscaler's Ottawa role is fully in-office and excluded. ServiceNow's Montréal FDE is hybrid but the complete posting does not disclose cadence and is primarily GenAI/ML delivery; it remains excluded from the scored target-family table.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 decisions
items: Assent (Senior DevOps Engineer: Data & AI Platform), Banyan Software (Forward Deployed Engineer), and Veeva (DevOps Engineer): all skipped by Marc's explicit call — not pursued.

method: Latest search run: September 18, 2026. Twenty-five unique current postings retained after direct-page validation, geographic screening and deduplication. The complete first results page was reviewed across 45 role/geography passes. Fourteen retained roles match existing pipeline records.
